items.stem: An initial deposit of ₹2,600 crore leads to the creation of total deposits of ₹20,800 crore in the banking system. Calculate the money multiplier and the legal reserve ratio. What would happen to total deposits if the reserve ratio were raised?
items.answer: Money multiplier = 8; LRR = 12.5%; a higher LRR would reduce total deposits
items.markingKey: k = total deposits ÷ initial deposit = 20800 ÷ 2600 = 8 (1 mark); LRR = 1 ÷ k = 12.5% (1 mark); a higher LRR lowers k, so total deposits fall (1 mark).

items.stem: Total deposits of ₹1,200 crore were created in the banking system when the legal reserve ratio was 25%. (i) Calculate the initial deposit. (ii) If the RBI changes the legal reserve ratio to 50%, what will be the total deposits created from the same initial deposit? (iii) State whether this is an expansionary or contractionary measure.
items.answer: (i) ₹300 crore; (ii) ₹600 crore; (iii) contractionary
items.markingKey: (i) Initial deposit = total deposits × LRR = 1200 × 0.25 = ₹300 crore (1 mark); (ii) new k = 1 ÷ 0.5 = 2, total = 300 × 2 = ₹600 crore (2 marks); (iii) the reserve ratio rises, so credit contracts: contractionary (1 mark).

items.stem:

The RBI is the sole authority for issuing currency notes in India except one-rupee notes. The RBI acts as banker, agent and adviser to the government."
(i) Explain the term 'open market operations', which is related to the theme of the extract. (1)
(ii) Using the extract and your own knowledge, explain the following: Open market sales of government securities reduce money supply. (1)

items.answer: (i) The purchase and sale of government securities by the RBI in the open market to change the money supply. items.markingKey: 1+1+2 marks: (i) The purchase and sale of government securities by the RBI in the open market to change the money supply. items.stem: Aisha deposits ₹800 crore in a commercial bank. The legal reserve ratio is 12.5%. Calculate (i) the amount the bank can lend in the first round, (ii) the money multiplier and (iii) the total deposits that can be created in the banking system.
items.answer: (i) ₹700 crore; (ii) 8; (iii) ₹6,400 crore
items.markingKey: (i) Reserves = 12.5% of 800 = 100, so loan = 800 − 100 = 700 (1 mark); (ii) k = 1 ÷ LRR = 8 (1 mark); (iii) total deposits = 800 × 8 = ₹6,400 crore (1 mark).
